description: This file defines a class 'GLGlobalInitializerStep' responsible for initializing global general ledger (GL) accounts in the Fineract system. It sets up multiple predefined GL accounts via API calls during system initialization, including account names, codes, types, and usage details.

classes.name: GLGlobalInitializerStep
classes.description: A Spring component class that initializes a set of predefined general ledger accounts in the system.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates multiple general ledger accounts using the API, initializing the system with predefined GL account data.
